news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path to Get World-Class Infrastructure
bullets: The JP Ganga Path will be developed with a 65 km long Ganga channel.
The project aims to enhance the overall development of the region.
This development is relevant to BPSC and BSSC exams as it falls under the infrastructure development category.

news_cards.title: Bihar Government to Develop Integrated Steel Project
bullets: A memorandum of understanding (MoU) has been signed between the Bihar government and Mahashakti Group for an integrated steel project in Gaya.
The project is worth Rs 6,000 crore.
This project is relevant to BPSC and BSSC exams as it falls under the category of industrial development.

news_cards.title: Bihar to Enhance RERA's Functionality
bullets: The Real Estate Regulatory Authority (RERA) in Bihar will be made more transparent, simple, and digital.
The main goal is to prioritize the interests of homebuyers.
This development is relevant to BPSC and BSSC exams as it falls under the category of regulatory reforms.

news_cards.title: Patna Metro Construction to Ensure Smooth Traffic
bullets: The construction of the Patna Metro will ensure smooth and uninterrupted traffic on Nehru Path.
If necessary, the road will be widened to facilitate traffic movement.
This development is relevant to BPSC and BSSC exams as it falls under the category of urban infrastructure development.

news_cards.title: Bihar Civil Services Exam 2025 Results
bullets: The results of the Bihar Civil Services Exam 2025 have been announced.
The successful candidates from Bihar have brought glory to the state.
This exam is relevant to BPSC exams as it is a key recruitment exam for state services.
